name: table-leaderboard
title: Leaderboard
description: Leaderboard. MDX/Table pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/mdx/Table and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-19.svg, /avatars/person-20.svg, /avatars/person-25.svg, /avatars/person-41.svg, /avatars/person-43.svg.

files.content:
import { Badge } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Pill'; import { AvatarRoot as Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Avatar'; import { TableRoot as Table, TableBodyPrimitive as TableBody, TableCellPrimitive as TableCell, TableHeadPrimitive as TableHead, TableHeader, TableRowPrimitive as TableRow } from '@gaudi/design-system/mdx/Table'; import { RegistryIcon } from '@gaudi/design-system/icons/RegistryIcon'; const leaders = [ { rank: 1, name: 'Sabine Okafor', handle: '@sarahchen', avatar: '/avatars/person-20.svg', score: 12840, change: '+320', changeUp: true, level: 'Diamond', levelVariant: 'info' }, { rank: 2, name: 'Dorian Oduya', handle: '@marcusj', avatar: '/avatars/person-41.svg', score: 11250, change: '+180', changeUp: true, level: 'Platinum', levelVariant: 'default' }, { rank: 3, name: 'Juno Saarinen', handle: '@emilyp', avatar: '/avatars/person-25.svg', score: 10890, change: '-45', changeUp: false, level: 'Platinum', levelVariant: 'default' }, { rank: 4, name: 'Ottilie Nakamura', handle: '@davidk', avatar: '/avatars/person-43.svg', score: 9420, change: '+520', changeUp: true, level: 'Gold', levelVariant: 'warning' }, { rank: 5, name: 'Sorrel Davanzo', handle: '@sofiad', avatar: '/avatars/person-19.svg', score: 8750, change: '+90', changeUp: true, level: 'Gold', levelVariant: 'warning' } ]; export function Pattern() { return (
# Player Level Score Change {leaders.map((leader) => ( {leader.rank}
{leader.name .split(' ') .map((n) => n[0]) .join('')}
{leader.name} {leader.handle}
{leader.level} {leader.score.toLocaleString()} {leader.changeUp ? ( ) : ( )} {leader.change} ))}
); }
